summary.en: A first-order baseline for one-dimensional constant-speed transport using the upstream value. The released periodic forward-Euler example exposes flow direction, the CFL restriction and numerical diffusion.

references.label: Courant, Isaacson & Rees (1952). On the solution of nonlinear hyperbolic differential equations by finite differences.
references.scope: Historical upstream-differencing lineage. Only bibliographic metadata were checked; the scalar update and CFL statement here come from the atlas code.

supports.ja: 風上差分に関係する歴史的な一次文献。今回は書誌を確認し、本サイトのスカラー更新式との対応や安定条件はコードから記述する。
supports.en: Historical primary source associated with upstream differencing. The local scalar specialization and stability condition are established from code inspection.

verification.locator: Publisher title, authors, year, volume and pages; full text unavailable.

assumptions: The problem is q_t+a q_x=0 with constant real a on a uniform grid.
The fully discrete difference_step uses forward Euler and switches between backward and forward differences according to the sign of C=a Δt/Δx.
For this linear periodic update, use |C|≤1 for stability and monotonicity. finite_difference alone is a spatial operator and does not specify a time integrator.
methods.units: q may have any consistent unit; x is length, t is time, and a is length/time. C=a Δt/Δx is dimensionless. Released periodic benchmarks are nondimensional.
methods.boundary_conditions: Periodic boundaries are imposed with np.roll. Inflow, outflow and wall boundaries require a separate ghost-state implementation.

limitations.ja: 空間・時間とも1次精度で、一般に波形や接触面を拡散させる。|C|>1ではこの陽的更新の安定性は保たれない。一定速度のスカラー例だけから、変係数・非線形系や多次元での保存性・安定性は保証しない。
limitations.en: First order in both space and time and generally diffusive for waves and contacts. The explicit periodic update is unstable for |C|>1. This constant-speed scalar example establishes no conservation or stability guarantee for variable-coefficient, nonlinear-system or multidimensional extensions.

metadata_review.level: method-specific source-and-code inspection; no numerical rerun; reference access recorded individually

assumptions_ja: 対象はq_t+a q_x=0、一定の実速度a、一様格子である。
公開の完全離散更新difference_stepは前進Eulerで、C=a Δt/Δxの符号に応じて後退差分と前進差分を切り替える。
この線形周期更新の安定性・単調性には|C|≤1を用いる。finite_difference単独は空間演算子であり時間積分法を指定しない。
methods.units_ja: qの単位は任意だが一貫させる。xは長さ、tは時間、aは長さ/時間で、C=a Δt/Δxは無次元。公開の周期ベンチマークは無次元化されている。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: np.rollによる周期境界。流入・流出や壁境界を扱うにはゴースト値の実装が別途必要で、現在の周期演算子をそのまま転用しない。

problem.en: Time evolution of a scalar distribution transported at constant speed.

variant.en: Sign-aware first-order upstream differencing in advection.py: forward Euler in difference_step and a periodic spatial derivative in finite_difference.

ja: 一定速度の周期移流で、安定性と数値拡散を分けて学ぶ。
高次法の比較用に簡単で単調な基準更新が必要で、|C|≤1を満たせる。
en: Study stability and numerical diffusion for constant-speed periodic advection.
Use a simple monotone baseline for comparison with higher-order methods when |C|≤1 can be enforced.

ja: 小さな拡散で細部を長時間保つ必要がある。
変速度の保存則や非周期境界を追加処理なしで解きたい。
en: Long-time preservation of fine features with little numerical diffusion is essential.
Variable-speed conservation laws or nonperiodic boundaries are required without additional treatment.

summary.ja: 保存則の各界面を局所Riemann問題として扱う有限体積の基準法。公開例は区分一定の空間再構成に近似流束とSSPRK3を組み合わせ、Sod問題で高次法との差を比較する。
summary.en: A finite-volume baseline using a local Riemann problem at each interface. The released example combines piecewise-constant spatial reconstruction, an approximate flux and SSPRK3, enabling comparison with higher-order solvers on Sod's problem.

references.scope: Original Godunov-method source. It is not evidence that the local SSPRK3/approximate-flux implementation reproduces the original fully discrete algorithm.

references.scope: Primary source for TVD Runge–Kutta time discretization and flux-based ENO construction; the local SSPRK(3,3) coefficients are independently visible in code.

supports.ja: 流束ベースの構成とTVD Runge–Kutta時間離散化に関する一次文献。ここで用いる3段3次の係数は公開コードで確認した。
supports.en: Primary source for TVD Runge–Kutta time discretization and flux-based construction. The atlas three-stage third-order coefficients were checked in code.

verification.locator: Publisher-indexed abstract and bibliographic record; full tableau not reviewed.

references.scope: Original HLLC contact-restoration source; no claim that all wave-speed estimates or WAF experiments in the paper are implemented.

supports.ja: HLL近似解へ接触波を復元する考え方の原報。論文中の各波速推定やWAF計算をすべて再現したという意味ではない。
supports.en: Primary source for restoring the contact wave missing from HLL. Its complete wave-speed alternatives and WAF experiments were not audited.

verification.locator: Publisher abstract and bibliographic record; full text not reviewed.

references.label: Sod (1978). A survey of several finite difference methods for systems of nonlinear hyperbolic conservation laws.
references.scope: Historical shock-tube comparison used as a benchmark source. The atlas reference is its own non-vacuum ideal-gas Riemann evaluator, with a bracketed numerical pressure solve.

supports.ja: Sod衝撃波管という比較課題の出典。参照値は本サイトの非真空・理想気体Riemann解評価器で求め、論文表を転記した値とは区別する。
supports.en: Benchmark provenance for the Sod shock tube. Atlas reference values come from its non-vacuum ideal-gas Riemann evaluator, rather than transcribed paper tables.

verification.locator: Publisher-indexed abstract and bibliographic record; detailed initial-state tables not reviewed.

assumptions: The scope is one-dimensional hyperbolic conservation laws on a uniform Cartesian grid with a model-compatible numerical flux.
Euler assumes a perfect gas and positive density/pressure; HLLC and other Euler fluxes are available. Shallow-water and isothermal models require HLL or Rusanov in this solver.
solve(...,method='godunov') sets reconstruction slopes to zero and advances with SSPRK(3,3). Initial data are sampled at grid locations and used as cell values.
The released solver requires 0<CFL≤0.5; this bound alone is not a positivity guarantee for arbitrary inputs.
methods.units: Use units consistent with each model's conserved variables and fluxes. Euler uses density ρ, momentum density ρu and total energy density E; each flux has its conserved-variable unit times length/time. Released shock tubes are nondimensional.
methods.boundary_conditions: The released _pad supplies periodic ghosts, fixed initial endpoint states, or edge extrapolation. Extrapolation is not an exact nonreflecting condition; reflecting walls and general inflow conditions are not implemented. Boundary fluxes contribute to global balances on nonperiodic domains.

limitations.ja: 空間1次なので衝撃波や接触面が広がる。原報の厳密Riemann解を用いる1段更新そのものではなく、時間3次でも全体の空間精度は1次のまま。近似流束・初期値の点サンプル・境界処理の選択に依存し、真空、乾湿境界、一般EOS、多次元および一般的な正値性・エントロピー保証は対象外。
limitations.en: First-order spatial reconstruction smears shocks and contacts. This is not the original one-step exact-Riemann algorithm, and third-order time stepping does not raise its spatial order. Results depend on the approximate flux, sampled initialization and boundary treatment. Vacuum, wet/dry fronts, general equations of state, multiple dimensions, and general positivity/entropy guarantees are outside scope.

metadata_review.level: method-specific source-and-code inspection; no numerical rerun; reference access recorded individually

assumptions_ja: 対象は1次元・一様Cartesian格子上の双曲型保存則で、各方程式に整合する流束を選ぶ。
Eulerでは理想気体、正の密度・圧力を前提とし、HLLC等を選べる。浅水・等温モデルにはHLLまたはRusanovを選ぶ。
公開solve(...,method='godunov')は傾きを0にし、SSPRK(3,3)で時間積分する。初期値は格子点でのサンプルをセル値として与える。
公開solverが受け付けるCFLは0<CFL≤0.5。この上限だけで任意の入力の正値性を保証するものではない。
methods.units_ja: 方程式ごとの保存変数と流束に一貫した単位を使う。Eulerでは密度ρ、運動量密度ρu、全エネルギー密度Eで、流束の単位は各保存量×長さ/時間。公開衝撃波管は無次元。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: 公開_padは周期、端点初期値固定、または端値の外挿でゴースト値を作る。外挿は厳密な無反射条件ではなく、反射壁や一般の流入条件は実装していない。非周期領域の総量変化には境界流束が入る。

problem.ja: 圧縮性流体など、衝撃波を含む1次元保存則の時間発展。
problem.en: Time evolution of one-dimensional conservation laws, including shocks in compressible flow.

variant.ja: solvers.solveのmethod='godunov': 区分一定状態＋選択した近似Riemann流束＋SSPRK(3,3)。既定Euler流束はHLLC。
variant.en: method='godunov' in solvers.solve: piecewise-constant states, a selected approximate Riemann flux and SSPRK(3,3). HLLC is the default Euler flux.

ja: 高次再構成の効果を測る、保守的な空間1次の比較基準が欲しい。
実装範囲内の1次元モデルで、波速に応じた時間刻みを選べる。
en: A conservative first-order spatial baseline is needed to measure the effect of higher-order reconstruction.
A supported one-dimensional model can be stepped according to its wave speeds.

ja: 接触面や滑らかな波を少ないセルで高精度に保ちたい。
真空・乾燥・複雑な境界を、この基準solverだけで保証付きに扱いたい。
en: Contacts or smooth waves must remain highly accurate on a coarse mesh.
Vacuum, dry states or complex boundaries require guarantees absent from this baseline solver.

assumptions: Approximate constant-coefficient −Δu=f by continuous P1 Galerkin elements: uniform intervals on [0,1] or affine triangles from diagonally split unit-square cells.
Element formulas assemble stiffness and consistent mass; forcing uses four-point Gauss quadrature in 1D and product Gauss quadrature under a Duffy transform on triangles.
Dirichlet rows/columns are symmetrically eliminated and the system is solved by ILU(0)-preconditioned GMRES; smooth manufactured solutions support L2/H1 error evaluation.
methods.units: Examples use dimensionless unit-length domains. With physical scaling, [f]=[u]/L²; stiffness and mass have geometric scales L^(d−2) and L^d in dimension d.
methods.boundary_conditions: Dirichlet data apply at both interval endpoints or the full unit-square perimeter; defaults are zero and callbacks allow nonzero data. This example does not assemble Neumann/Robin boundary integrals.

limitations.ja: 汎用メッシュ生成や曲線要素、可変係数、混合要素の実装ではない。L2で2次・H1半ノルムで1次という既存の検査は滑らかな製造解と本メッシュの範囲であり、角の特異性や任意領域へ無条件に一般化しない。
limitations.en: Not a general mesh generator or implementation of curved elements, variable coefficients or mixed elements. Existing second-order L2 and first-order H1-seminorm tests concern smooth manufactured solutions on these meshes; do not generalize them unconditionally to corner singularities or arbitrary domains.

assumptions_ja: 定係数の −Δu=f を連続P1 Galerkin空間で近似する。1次元は [0,1] の一様区間、2次元は単位正方形を対角分割したアフィン三角形。
剛性・整合質量行列は要素公式を使う。右辺は1次元4点Gauss求積、三角形はDuffy変換の積Gauss求積で評価する。
Dirichletの行と列を対称に消去し、ILU(0)付きGMRESで解く。滑らかな製造解のL2/H1誤差評価を備える。
methods.units_ja: 公開例は無次元の長さ1の領域。物理尺度を付けるなら [f]=[u]/L²、次元dの剛性行列はL^(d−2)、質量行列はL^dの幾何学的尺度を持つ。

summary.en: An approximate Riemann flux that restores the contact wave missing from HLL, improving Euler contact resolution. The released implementation is one-dimensional and perfect-gas, with Davis-type outer acoustic speeds.

verification.locator: Publisher abstract and metadata; wave-speed formulae in full text not reviewed.

references.scope: Historical shock-tube comparison used as a benchmark source. The atlas reference is its own non-vacuum ideal-gas Riemann evaluator, with a bracketed numerical pressure solve.

supports.ja: Sod衝撃波管という比較課題の出典。参照値は本サイトの非真空・理想気体Riemann解評価器で求め、論文表を転記した値とは区別する。
supports.en: Benchmark provenance for the Sod shock tube. Atlas reference values come from its non-vacuum ideal-gas Riemann evaluator, rather than transcribed paper tables.

verification.locator: Publisher-indexed abstract and bibliographic record; detailed initial-state tables not reviewed.

assumptions: Left/right states are perfect-gas Euler variables (ρ,ρu,E), finite with ρ>0 and p>0, using a physical γ>1.
Outer speeds are S_L=min(u_L−c_L,u_R−c_R) and S_R=max(u_L+c_L,u_R+c_R); the contact speed and two star states are computed algebraically.
HLLC supplies an interface flux. Reconstruction, time integration, CFL control and boundary states are provided by the caller.
The local HLLC branch accepts Euler only; availability of HLL for another model does not make this HLLC implementation applicable to it.
methods.units: Use one consistent unit system on both sides. ρ is density, u, c and wave speeds are length/time, and p and E are energy/volume. Numerical fluxes have conserved-variable units times length/time. γ is dimensionless; released examples are nondimensional.
methods.boundary_conditions: Physical boundary conditions do not belong to the interface-flux function. The caller constructs left/right states; the existing one-dimensional solver uses periodic, fixed-initial-endpoint or extrapolated-edge states.

limitations.ja: 接触波の復元は一般的な正値性・エントロピー安定性の保証ではない。このDavis型波速版を、強い希薄波・真空や一般EOS、MHD、相対論的流体に追加処理なしで用いない。静止接触の一致テストも、移動衝撃波や全問題での厳密性を意味しない。
limitations.en: Contact restoration is not a general positivity or entropy-stability guarantee. This Davis-speed version should not be extended without additional treatment to strong rarefactions, vacuum, general equations of state, MHD or relativistic flow. Exact agreement for a stationary contact does not imply an exact solution for moving shocks or arbitrary problems.

metadata_review.level: method-specific source-and-code inspection; no numerical rerun; reference access recorded individually

assumptions_ja: 左右状態は理想気体Eulerの(ρ,ρu,E)、有限かつρ>0、p>0で、物理的な比熱比γ>1を使う。
外側波速はS_L=min(u_L−c_L,u_R−c_R)、S_R=max(u_L+c_L,u_R+c_R)。接触速度と左右star状態を代数的に計算する。
HLLCは界面流束であり、再構成、時間積分、CFLと境界状態は呼び出し側が与える。
本実装のHLLC分岐はEuler専用であり、HLLを使える他のモデルにも自動適用できるわけではない。
methods.units_ja: 左右で同じ単位系を使う。ρは密度、uとcと各波速は長さ/時間、pとEはエネルギー/体積。数値流束は保存量×長さ/時間の単位を持つ。γは無次元で、公開例も無次元。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: 界面流束そのものには物理境界条件を指定しない。呼び出し元が左右状態を作る。既存1次元solverは周期・端点初期値固定・端値外挿を用いる。

problem.ja: セル界面の左右Euler状態から、接触波を含む近似保存流束を求める。
problem.en: Compute a contact-resolving approximate conservative flux from left/right Euler states.

variant.ja: riemann.numerical_flux(...,solver='hllc')。Davis型外側波速、左右star状態、接触波を使う理想気体Euler版。
variant.en: riemann.numerical_flux(...,solver='hllc'): perfect-gas Euler HLLC with Davis-type outer speeds, two star states and a contact wave.

ja: 正の理想気体状態から、HLLより鮮明な密度接触面を求めたい。
再構成・時間積分・境界条件を別に選ぶGodunov型solverの流束部品が必要。
en: Density contacts should be sharper than with HLL for positive perfect-gas states.
A flux component is needed in a Godunov-type solver that separately selects reconstruction, time integration and boundaries.

ja: 真空や極端な希薄波に対して正値性の保証が必須。
非理想気体、浅水、MHD等のための別のHLLC定式化が必要。
en: Guaranteed positivity is required near vacuum or extreme rarefactions.
A different HLLC formulation is needed for nonideal gases, shallow water or MHD.

summary.ja: 滑らかな非硬い常微分方程式を4回の右辺評価で4次精度に進める古典Runge–Kutta法。公開例では次数条件、安定関数、非線形・時刻依存問題を比較し、SSP性やシンプレクティック性とは区別する。
summary.en: Classical four-stage Runge–Kutta advances smooth nonstiff ODEs with fourth-order accuracy. Released examples compare order conditions, stability functions and nonlinear/time-dependent problems while distinguishing accuracy from SSP and symplectic properties.

methods.code_mapping_scope: Related chapter modules and test files; not a claim that each test covers every named method.

references.label: Butcher (1963). Coefficients for the study of Runge-Kutta integration processes.
references.scope: Primary formulation of Runge–Kutta order conditions, including fourth-order conditions; not attributed as the historical invention of classical RK4.

supports.ja: Runge–Kutta法の次数条件を定式化した一次文献。4次条件を扱う本文を確認したが、古典RK4の発明論文という意味では引用しない。
supports.en: Primary order-condition formulation, with the fourth-order discussion inspected. This is not presented as the historical invention paper for classical RK4.

verification.locator: Runge–Kutta definitions and p. 196 fourth-order conditions; relevant portions read, not every proof.

assumptions: The target is the initial-value problem y'=f(t,y), with sufficient smoothness of f and y for fourth-order convergence.
The adopted classical tableau has c=(0,1/2,1/2,1), a21=1/2, a32=1/2, a43=1 and b=(1,2,2,1)/6.
The caller selects the step. A semidiscrete PDE also imposes spatial spectral/CFL restrictions; linear modes require |R(hλ)|≤1.
methods.units: h and t have the same time unit, and f_i has units y_i/time. State-component units belong to the problem; RK4 imposes no intrinsic physical unit. hλ is dimensionless.
methods.boundary_conditions: Spatial boundary conditions do not apply to the ODE step itself. For a PDE, each stage's RHS evaluation must supply the appropriate boundary values or ghost states.

limitations.ja: 陽解法でA安定・L安定ではなく、硬い減衰では小さい刻みを要する。一般の非線形問題に正のSSP係数を持たず、正値性・TVD性・エネルギー保存・シンプレクティック性を4次精度から導くことはできない。このrk_stepは固定刻みの部品で、埋込み誤差推定や自動刻み調整を持たない。
limitations.en: Explicit RK4 is neither A-stable nor L-stable and may require small steps for stiff decay. It has no positive general nonlinear SSP coefficient; fourth-order accuracy implies neither positivity, TVD, energy conservation nor symplecticity. The released rk_step is a fixed-step component without an embedded error estimator or adaptive controller.

metadata_review.level: method-specific source-and-code inspection; no numerical rerun; reference access recorded individually

assumptions_ja: 対象は初期値問題y'=f(t,y)で、4次収束を期待する区間では右辺と解に十分な滑らかさがある。
時間刻みは呼び出し側が選び、空間離散したPDEではそのスペクトル・CFL制約にも従う。線形モードでは|R(hλ)|≤1を確認する。
methods.units_ja: 時間hとtは同じ単位、f_iはy_i/時間の単位。状態成分の単位は問題が定め、RK4自体は固有の物理単位を持たない。hλは無次元。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: 時間ステップ単体に空間境界条件は該当しない。PDEを進める場合、境界値やゴースト状態は各段階の右辺評価が正しく供給する必要がある。

problem.ja: 滑らかな常微分方程式・空間離散後の系の初期値問題。
problem.en: Initial-value problems for smooth ODEs or semidiscrete systems.

variant.ja: runge_kutta.TABLEAUS['rk4']の古典4段4次とrk_step。Hamiltonian比較にも同じ古典係数のRK4がある。
variant.en: Classical four-stage fourth-order TABLEAUS['rk4'] and rk_step in runge_kutta.py; the Hamiltonian comparison also uses classical RK4 coefficients.

ja: 非硬い滑らかな問題で、誤差と刻み幅の関係を明快に調べたい。
4回の右辺評価を許容でき、固定刻みや別の刻み制御を管理できる。
en: A smooth nonstiff problem needs a clear accuracy/step-size baseline.
Four RHS evaluations per step are affordable, with fixed-step or external step control.

ja: 非常に硬い減衰やDAEを汎用に解く。
SSP性・正値性や長時間のHamilton構造保存が必須。
en: Very stiff decay or general DAEs must be handled.
SSP/positivity guarantees or long-time Hamiltonian structure preservation are essential.

reason.ja: 公開tableauと非自律段階時刻を確認。
reason.en: Inspected the released tableau and nonautonomous stage times.

reason.ja: y+h fという段階式から成分ごとに定義。
reason.en: Specified componentwise from stage updates of the form y+h f.

reason.ja: rk_stepは右辺関数を受け取る時間積分部品。
reason.en: rk_step is a time integrator that receives an RHS function.

reason.ja: 線形安定性と非線形SSP性・幾何学的性質を区別。
reason.en: Separates linear stability from nonlinear SSP and geometric properties.

summary.ja: runge_kutta.pyのrk4係数・rk_step・安定関数を読んだ。test_runge_kutta.pyの4次条件、非自律非線形製造解、安定関数とSSP非成立の検査、およびHamiltonian比較の既存テストを確認。今回の再実行なし。
summary.en: Read the RK4 tableau, rk_step and stability functions in runge_kutta.py. Inspected tests for fourth-order conditions, a manufactured nonautonomous nonlinear solution, stability functions, failure of general SSP conditions, and the Hamiltonian comparison. No rerun was performed.

ja: Kuttaの歴史的原報の本文・優先権の調査。
新しい数値実行、任意の右辺・不連続時刻・硬いPDEへの検証。
en: Historical Kutta full text and priority claims.
New numerical runs or validation for arbitrary RHS functions, time discontinuities or stiff PDEs.

assumptions: The target is an ODE y'=f(t,y) represented by a real one-dimensional array, with a consistent Jacobian ∂f/∂y supplied by the caller.
A=[[γ,0],[1−γ,γ]], b=(1−γ,γ), c=(γ,1), and γ=1−1/√2. This stiffly accurate form returns the last stage.
With exact stage solves, R(z)=[1+(1−2γ)z]/(1−γz)^2. This γ gives A-stability and R→0 as |z|→∞ in the left half-plane.

Newton convergence is required at each stage. Distinguish fixed-step integrate from adaptive_sdirk2, which estimates error from (two half steps−one full step)/3 and accepts the two-half-step solution.
methods.units: h has time units, f_i has y_i/time, and J_ij has y_i/(y_j×time). Nondimensionalization or component scaling is needed: the fixed Newton tolerance 2×10^-12 does not automatically adapt to arbitrary physical units. Adaptive atol sets state scales and rtol is dimensionless.
methods.boundary_conditions: Spatial boundaries do not apply to the ODE time step itself. For semidiscrete PDEs, incorporate boundary conditions and their time dependence consistently into the RHS and Jacobian.

limitations.ja: L安定性は正確な段階解を前提とする線形試験方程式の性質であり、大刻みの精度・非線形収束・正値性を保証しない。Newton失敗時は固定版が例外、適応版が試行棄却を行う。埋込み対ではなくステップ倍化で、rtol/atolは局所誤差尺度であり最終大域誤差の保証ではない。一般DAE、質量行列、イベント処理は未実装。
limitations.en: L-stability concerns the linear test equation with accurate stage solves; it guarantees neither large-step accuracy, nonlinear convergence nor positivity. A Newton failure raises in the fixed version and rejects a trial in the adaptive wrapper. Adaptivity uses step doubling, not an embedded pair; rtol/atol control a local error scale, not a guaranteed final global error. General DAEs, mass matrices and events are not implemented.

assumptions_ja: 対象は実数の1次元配列で表すODE y'=f(t,y)。整合するJacobian ∂f/∂yを呼び出し側が与える。
A=[[γ,0],[1−γ,γ]]、b=(1−γ,γ)、c=(γ,1)、γ=1−1/√2。最終段を次の解にするstiffly accurate版。
正確な段階解に対する安定関数はR(z)=[1+(1−2γ)z]/(1−γz)^2。このγではA安定かつ左半平面で|z|→∞のときR→0となる。
実装では各段階のNewton収束が必要。固定刻みintegrateと、(2半歩−1全歩)/3を使って2半歩の解を採用するadaptive_sdirk2を区別する。
methods.units_ja: hは時間、f_iはy_i/時間、Jacobian要素J_ijはy_i/(y_j×時間)。無次元化または成分尺度の調整が必要で、固定のNewton許容値2×10^-12は任意の物理単位に自動対応しない。適応版のatolは状態尺度、rtolは無次元。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: ODE時間積分単体には空間境界条件は該当しない。PDEの半離散系に使う場合、境界条件とその時刻依存性を右辺とJacobianへ整合して組み込む。

assumptions: The released example is an autonomous separable one-degree-of-freedom Hamiltonian H(q,p)=p²/2+V(q) with unit mass and V=q²/2 or q²/2+q⁴/4.
The force is −V'(q), depending only on position. The update is p_half=p−h V'(q)/2, q_new=q+h p_half, p_new=p_half−h V'(q_new)/2.
Reversibility and symplecticity refer to the same fixed-step map. Dynamical time scales must still be resolved for accuracy and stability.
methods.units: The released oscillator is nondimensional with m=1 and harmonic ω=1. A general-mass formulation would require drift h p/m and consistent position, momentum, force and time scales; that generalization is not an input feature of this released function.
methods.boundary_conditions: Spatial boundary conditions do not apply to this oscillator phase-space map. It is a different problem from the original periodic Lennard-Jones fluid; particle periodicity, walls and constraints are not implemented here.

limitations.ja: 元のHamiltonianを各ステップで厳密保存するわけではない。シンプレクティックでも大刻みは不安定になり得て、ω=1の調和振動子では|h|<2が安定域の内部。速度依存力、摩擦・サーモスタット、拘束、一般の可変刻みや非分離Hamiltonianでは、同じ性質をそのまま保証できない。公開関数は一般分子動力学solverではない。
limitations.en: The original Hamiltonian is not exactly preserved at each step. A symplectic map can still be unstable at large steps; for the ω=1 harmonic oscillator, |h|<2 is the interior stability interval. Velocity-dependent forces, friction/thermostats, constraints, generic variable steps and nonseparable Hamiltonians require different treatment. This function is not a general molecular-dynamics solver.

summary.ja: 実対称正定値な連立一次方程式を共役方向で反復的に解く。公開例は単位正方形・零Dirichlet Poisson方程式の五点差分を、行列を組み立てずに扱う前処理なしCG。
summary.en: Solve real SPD linear systems by conjugate directions. The public example is unpreconditioned matrix-free CG for the five-point zero-Dirichlet Poisson operator on a unit square.

references.label: Hestenes, M. R. & Stiefel, E. (1952). Methods of Conjugate Gradients for Solving Linear Systems.
references.scope: Real SPD conjugate-gradient recurrence; not the heat time integrator used elsewhere in the chapter.

supports.ja: 実対称正定値系に対するCGの反復式と、丸め誤差がある場合の有限回終了の限界。
supports.en: CG recurrence for real SPD systems and the qualification of finite termination in floating-point arithmetic.

verification.locator: Sections 2–3, especially (3:1) and the discussion of rounding error, pp. 410–411.

assumptions: The operator must be real SPD and the right-hand side finite; the example discretizes constant-coefficient −Δu=f on a uniform square grid.
Inner products are Euclidean array products; the current implementation starts from zero and has no preconditioner.
poisson_comparison.solve stops on a recomputed true relative residual; linear.poisson_2d uses a recurrence residual with tolerance×max(1,initial residual).
methods.units: CG has no intrinsic physical unit. The public Poisson coordinates have unit dimensionless length; dimensionally [f]=[u]/[length]². Residual norms are unweighted array norms.
methods.boundary_conditions: CG itself supplies no physical boundary condition. The public 2D Poisson examples impose u=0 on every side of [0,1]² by zero padding.

limitations.ja: 非対称・不定・特異な系にそのまま適用しない。前処理、一般疎行列入力、純Neumannの零空間処理はこのCG例にはない。小さい残差は離散化誤差の保証ではなく、単一固有モードの速い終了を一般的性能と解釈しない。
limitations.en: Do not apply this variant directly to nonsymmetric, indefinite or singular systems. This CG example has no preconditioner, general sparse-matrix interface or pure-Neumann nullspace handling. A small residual does not certify discretization accuracy; rapid termination for one eigenmode is not a general performance result.

assumptions_ja: 作用素は実対称正定値で、右辺は有限。ここでは定係数の −Δu=f を一様正方格子で離散化する。
内積は配列成分のEuclidean内積。既存実装の初期値は零で、前処理は用いない。
poisson_comparison.solve は再計算した真の相対残差を停止に使う。linear.poisson_2d は反復残差と tolerance×max(1,初期残差) を使う。
methods.units_ja: CG自体に固有の物理単位はない。公開Poisson例は長さ1の無次元座標で、次元を与えるなら [f]=[u]/[長さ]²。残差は格子体積で重み付けしない配列ノルム。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: 代数解法としてのCGは境界を定めない。公開2次元Poisson例は [0,1]² の全辺で u=0 をゼロ埋め込みにより課す。

supports.ja: 粗密の格子間で情報を交換する多重格子法の一次研究。論文中の適応格子機能を実装済みとはしない。
supports.en: Primary multilevel boundary-value research; its adaptive capabilities are not claimed for the fixed-grid atlas example.

verification.locator: Abstract on printed p. 333 available in indexed primary-paper text; full PDF fetched but no readable body extracted. Author bibliography separately checked.

assumptions: Constant-coefficient −Δu=f on a uniform square interior grid with n=2^k−1 per axis.
Coarse operators are rediscretized five-point operators; restriction is full weighting, prolongation bilinear, with three red-black Gauss–Seidel pre/post sweeps by default.
The one-unknown coarsest problem is solved exactly. Entry points use either mixed absolute/relative residual stopping or the comparison's true relative residual.
methods.units: The public problem uses dimensionless [0,1]² and h=1/(n+1). Dimensionally [f]=[u]/[length]²; residual norms have no mesh weights.
methods.boundary_conditions: u=0 on all sides of [0,1]². Error corrections also have homogeneous Dirichlet boundaries, implemented by zero padding.

limitations.ja: 固定された正方形・定係数・入れ子格子の教育例。AMG、不規則格子、適応細分化、強い異方性や不連続係数用の特別な平滑化は実装しない。Brandt論文の全機能や任意問題での最適計算量を示すものではない。
limitations.en: An educational fixed-square, constant-coefficient nested-grid example. It does not implement AMG, irregular meshes, adaptive refinement or specialized smoothing for strong anisotropy/discontinuous coefficients. It does not establish all capabilities of Brandt's paper or optimal work for arbitrary problems.

assumptions_ja: 定係数の −Δu=f、正方形の一様内部格子、各軸 n=2^k−1 の入れ子格子を仮定する。

summary.ja: 非線形方程式 F(x)=0 を、Jacobianから求めたNewton方向と残差ノルムの十分減少による減衰で解く。公開例は密行列解法または前処理付きGMRESの内部解法を選べる。
summary.en: Solve F(x)=0 using a Jacobian-based Newton direction and damping that requires sufficient decrease of the residual norm. The example supports a dense or preconditioned GMRES inner solve.

methods.code_mapping_scope: Related chapter modules and test files; not a claim that each test covers every named method.

references.label: Armijo, L. (1966). Minimization of functions having Lipschitz continuous first partial derivatives.
references.scope: Source for sufficient-decrease and halving-backtracking ideas; the atlas adapts the test to ||F||, not to the paper's steepest-descent problem.

supports.ja: 十分減少と刻みの半減という考え方の根拠。原論文の最小化の収束定理を、この非線形方程式実装の保証とはしない。
supports.en: Supports sufficient decrease and step halving; the minimization theorem is not a convergence certificate for this root solver.

verification.locator: Printed pp. 1–3; convergence theorem and Corollary 2, equation (2).

references.label: Dembo, R. S., Eisenstat, S. C. & Steihaug, T. (1982). Inexact Newton Methods.
references.scope: Newton equations and approximate inner linear solves; context for the GMRES path, not proof of the atlas's particular forcing rule.

supports.ja: Newton方程式を近似的に解く定式化。今回確認したのは抄録であり、実装固有の内部許容誤差の定理適合は未確認。
supports.en: Formulates approximate Newton solves; only the abstract was reviewed, not a theorem audit of the implemented inner tolerance.

verification.locator: Publisher abstract and bibliographic metadata, as returned by web search; direct full text not reviewed.

assumptions: The caller supplies F and its Jacobian; the basic setting is a square differentiable system with a nonsingular Jacobian near the root.
Starting at one, the step is halved until ||F(x+αs)||₂ ≤ (1−10⁻⁴α)||F(x)||₂; failure is returned below α=2⁻²⁰.
The GMRES path still uses an explicitly supplied Jacobian; CSR uses ILU(0), otherwise Jacobi preconditioning. Inner and outer absolute residual criteria differ.
methods.units: No intrinsic physical unit; the caller defines unknown and residual scales. Components are not nondimensionalized automatically, so scale them consistently before using the norm and absolute tolerance.
methods.boundary_conditions: Newton has no intrinsic physical boundary. F/Jacobian assembly supplies it; the existing Bratu test encodes zero Dirichlet values at both ends of [0,1].

limitations.ja: 初期値、Jacobianの非特異性、残差の尺度に依存し、大域的収束は保証しない。特異な密行列解法や前処理構築は例外となることがあり、すべてが失敗理由の戻り値に変換されるわけではない。行列なしJv、信頼領域、継続法は備えない。
limitations.en: Convergence depends on the initial guess, Jacobian nonsingularity and residual scaling; global convergence is not guaranteed. Singular dense solves or preconditioner construction may raise exceptions rather than return a failure reason. No matrix-free Jv, trust region or continuation is provided.

metadata_review.level: method-specific sources and implementation inspected; no new numerical rerun

assumptions_ja: FとJacobianを利用者が与える。平方の微分可能な系と、解の近くで非特異なJacobianが基本となる。
長さ1から1/2ずつ減らし、||F(x+αs)||₂ ≤ (1−10⁻⁴α)||F(x)||₂ を要求する。α<2⁻²⁰で失敗を返す。
GMRES経路でもJacobianは明示的に与える。CSRならILU(0)、それ以外ならJacobi前処理を使い、内部残差と外部絶対残差を区別する。
methods.units_ja: 固有の物理単位はなく、未知数・残差の尺度は呼び出し側が決める。単位・桁の違う残差成分を自動で無次元化しないため、ノルムと絶対許容誤差を使う前に尺度を揃える。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: Newton法自体に物理境界はない。境界はFとJacobianの組立て側が指定する。既存Bratu検査は [0,1] の両端零Dirichletを内部未知数の残差へ組み込む。

ja: Jacobianを与えられ、根の候補に近い初期値があるとき。
非線形問題で線形解法の誤差と減衰の作用を分けて確認するとき。
en: A Jacobian and an initial guess near a candidate root are available.
Examining the separate effects of inner linear accuracy and damping.

ja: Jacobianが特異になる点や、解が複数ある問題を初期値依存なしに解きたい場合。
制約付き最適化やJacobianなしの巨大問題をこのまま解く場合。
en: Requiring initial-guess-independent results near singular Jacobians or multiple roots.
Direct use for constrained optimization or very large Jacobian-free problems.

reason.ja: 受理不等式、半減、Jacobianと内部解法を確認した。
reason.en: Inspected the acceptance inequality, halving, Jacobian and inner solvers.

reason.ja: ソルバーによる尺度変換はなく絶対ノルムを使う。
reason.en: No automatic scaling; the solver uses an absolute norm.

reason.ja: 境界は残差とJacobianの定義に属する。
reason.en: Boundaries belong to the supplied residual/Jacobian.

reason.ja: 失敗理由と例外が返る経路を区別した。
reason.en: Distinguished returned failures from exception paths.

summary.ja: krylov.newtonと、立方関数での後退・反復上限、1次元BratuのNewton–GMRES格子細分化を扱う既存検査定義を読んだ。今回は再実行していない。
summary.en: Inspected krylov.newton and existing cubic backtracking/iteration-limit and 1D Bratu Newton–GMRES refinement tests; no rerun.

ja: 一般初期値からの大域的収束、特異点や分岐への対応。
実装固有の内部許容誤差が文献の収束定理を満たすことの証明。

Proof that the implemented inner tolerance satisfies a particular literature convergence theorem.

references.scope: Primary PM charge-sharing/CIC and Fourier-force-shaping research in 2D; context for assignment and mesh-force errors, not a derivation of this 3D gravity implementation.

supports.ja: PMのCICを含む割当てと格子の力の誤差に直接関係する一次研究。2次元の論文であり、本実装の3次元Green関数を検証する文献とはしない。
supports.en: Directly supports PM assignment/CIC and mesh-force error context; this 2D paper is not a validation of the implemented 3D Green function.

verification.locator: Publisher abstract and metadata returned by web search; full text not reviewed.

assumptions: A cubic periodic box, positive finite particle masses, finite positions, cubic n³ mesh with n≥4 and L>0; coordinates wrap modulo L in every axis.
CIC deposits to eight vertices with product-linear weights divided by cell volume; interpolation uses the same weights. No CIC-window deconvolution is applied.
∇²φ=4πG(ρ−meanρ), with φ̂(0)=0. Nonzero modes use −4πG/k² and acceleration is −∇φ. On even meshes, each derivative zeroes its own-axis Nyquist mode to retain a real odd operator.
methods.units: pm_acceleration is a dimensionless G=1 example. L and positions share a length unit; density, potential and acceleration scale as M/L³, GM/L and GM/L². Only the lower-level periodic_poisson accepts a positive gravity parameter.
methods.boundary_conditions: Periodic in all directions with box length L. Mean removal enforces periodic-Poisson compatibility, while zeroing k=0 fixes the additive potential gauge. This is not the isolated-force problem.

limitations.ja: 格子以下の近接力を直接補正しないPMのみの静的例。CIC平滑化、格子異方性・aliasing・有限解像度があり、連続Fourier Green関数を有限差分Laplacianの離散逆作用素と混同しない。P3M・TreePM分割・Ewald・PME/SPME・宇宙膨張・時間積分は含まない。
limitations.en: A static PM-only example without direct short-range correction. CIC smoothing, grid anisotropy, aliasing and finite resolution remain; the continuum Fourier Green function is not the inverse symbol of a finite-difference Laplacian. No P3M, TreePM split, Ewald, PME/SPME, expansion or time integration is included.

metadata_review.level: method-specific sources and implementation inspected; no new numerical rerun

assumptions_ja: 立方体の周期箱、正かつ有限の粒子質量、有限位置、立方n³格子でn≥4、L>0を使う。位置は各軸でLを法として折り返す。
CICは8隅への積線形重みで密度を作り、格子体積で割る。粒子へ戻す補間も同じ重み。CIC窓の逆補正は行わない。
∇²φ=4πG(ρ−平均ρ)、φ̂(0)=0。非零モードは −4πG/k²、加速度は−∇φ。偶数格子の微分は各軸の対応Nyquistモードを零にして実の奇作用素を保つ。
methods.units_ja: pm_accelerationはG=1固定の無次元例。L・位置には同じ長さ単位を使い、ρは質量/L³、φはGM/L、加速度はGM/L²に対応する。下位関数periodic_poissonのみ正のgravityを指定できる。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: 全方向周期、箱長L。平均密度を除くことで周期Poissonの整合性を満たし、k=0を零に固定してポテンシャルの加法定数を選ぶ。孤立境界の力とは同一問題でない。

assumptions: Positions are finite (N,3), masses positive and finite, and N≥1; ε=softening>0, theta≥0 and order is 0 or 2.
A node is accepted when s/d<theta, with s=2×half and d measured to its center of mass. Target-containing cells are always opened; leaves exclude self terms.
The acceleration kernel is −m r/(r²+ε²)^(3/2). order=2 adds the full Taylor term from S=Σmδδᵀ, retaining trace(S) for the softened kernel.
methods.units: Dimensionless G=1. Positions and softening share a length unit and masses use one consistent unit. With scales L₀,M₀, acceleration is restored with GM₀/L₀².
methods.boundary_conditions: Isolated boundaries without periodic images; the softened potential −Gm/√(r²+ε²) tends to zero at infinity. This is a different boundary problem from periodic PM, Ewald or TreePM.

limitations.ja: 静的な力の教育例で、時間積分・宇宙膨張・周期境界・FMMを含まない。thetaは厳密な誤差上限ではなく、order=2がすべての配置で常に改善する保証もない。対象ごとの近似なので厳密な作用反作用・全運動量保存は保証せず、相互作用回数は実時間や全分布でのO(N log N)の実測ではない。
limitations.en: A static-force educational example without time integration, expansion, periodic images or FMM. theta is not a rigorous error bound, and order=2 need not improve every configuration. Targetwise approximation does not guarantee exact action–reaction/total-momentum conservation. Interaction counts are not timings or empirical complexity guarantees for every distribution.

assumptions_ja: 位置は有限の(N,3)配列、質量は正かつ有限、粒子数は1以上。softening=ε>0、theta≥0、orderは0または2。
節点の一辺s=2×half、質量中心までの距離dについて s/d<theta なら受理する。ただし対象粒子を含むセルは必ず開き、葉では自己項を除く。
加速度核は −m r/(r²+ε²)^(3/2)。order=2はS=Σmδδᵀの完全なTaylor項を加え、軟化された核に必要なtrace(S)項も保持する。
methods.units_ja: 無次元のG=1。位置と軟化長は同じ長さ単位、質量には一貫した単位を使う。長さL₀・質量M₀で次元を戻す場合、加速度の尺度はGM₀/L₀²。

summary.en: Represent reference-interval functions in Legendre modes. The implementation tabulates P₀…Pₚ and derivatives, optionally normalizes them, and computes unweighted L2 projection and affine element matrices by Gauss quadrature.

assumptions: The reference interval is [−1,1] with weight one: ∫PⱼPₖdξ=2δⱼₖ/(2k+1); orthonormal=True multiplies by √((2k+1)/2).
Degree is a nonnegative integer. project_legendre approximates projection integrals by Gauss quadrature, leaving quadrature error for general functions.
Exact element-matrix quadrature means p+1 Gauss points for polynomial products with constant coefficients and an affine map.
methods.units: ξ and basis values are dimensionless. On an affine interval of length L, J=L/2 scales mass by J and gradient stiffness by 1/J. Expansion coefficients share the represented function's units.
methods.boundary_conditions: Basis evaluation/projection imposes no physical boundary condition. Endpoint values/fluxes and interelement coupling belong to the consuming discretization; the constant stiffness nullspace is not removed automatically.

limitations.ja: 中程度の次数向けの教育用表作成で、高次数での安定性・最適化を保証しない。不連続関数では単一多項式の収束と求積が制約される。Chebyshev基底の重みをLegendreの重み1と混同せず、GLL求積による最高モードの質量を厳密質量と同一視しない。
limitations.en: Educational tabulation for modest degrees, without high-degree stability/performance guarantees. Discontinuities limit single-polynomial approximation and quadrature. Do not confuse Chebyshev weights with the unit Legendre weight, or GLL quadrature's highest-mode mass with exact mass.

assumptions_ja: 参照区間 [−1,1]、重み1の内積を採用する。∫PⱼPₖdξ=2δⱼₖ/(2k+1)、orthonormal指定時は√((2k+1)/2)を掛ける。
degreeは0以上の整数。project_legendreはGauss求積で射影積分を近似するため、一般関数に対して求積誤差も残る。
element_matricesの厳密求積指定は定係数・アフィン写像下の多項式積を対象とし、p+1点Gaussを使う。

assumptions: Interval nodes must be distinct finite real values at modest degree; cardinal polynomials are evaluated through a Legendre Vandermonde solve.
For p≥1, GLL nodes are ±1 and roots of Pₚ′. A p+1-point GLL rule is exact through degree 2p−1, not generally for degree-2p mass products.
Triangle functions are only P1/P2 on (0,0),(1,0),(0,1). Quadrilaterals use Qₚ tensor products with (p+1)² degrees of freedom.
methods.units: Reference coordinates/basis values are dimensionless; nodal values carry the function's units. Affine interval matrices scale as M∝J and K∝1/J with J=L/2.
methods.boundary_conditions: GLL includes endpoints but does not itself enforce Dirichlet values or interelement continuity. The consuming discretization supplies values, fluxes and coupling.

limitations.ja: 高次数のVandermonde解法は条件数の制約を受け、安定なbarycentric表作成や汎用高次要素の代替ではない。等間隔節点の高次補間にはRunge現象がある。GLL集中質量と厳密質量のrank-1差は重み1・アフィン区間での結果で、三角形全般へ適用しない。
limitations.en: High-degree Vandermonde solves face conditioning limits and are not a replacement for stable barycentric tabulation or a general high-order element library. High-degree equispaced interpolation can exhibit Runge behavior. The rank-one exact/lumped GLL mass difference concerns the unweighted affine interval, not arbitrary triangles.

assumptions: The scope is one-dimensional perfect-gas Euler on a uniform Cartesian grid, with finite positive density and pressure at each stage.
q contains point values, not cell averages. A global a=max|u±c| splits f±=(f±a q)/2; oppositely biased five-point stencils reconstruct the two fluxes.
Weights use d=(0.1,0.6,0.3), Jiang–Shu β_k, τ_5=|β_0−β_2| and α_k=d_k[1+(τ_5/(ε+β_k))²], with default ε=10^-6.
Both split fluxes use the same face-frozen Roe characteristic basis by default; component reconstruction is optional. Time integration is SSPRK(3,3), with 0<CFL≤0.5.
methods.units: Released Euler examples are nondimensional. With dimensional data, β and τ scale as the squared projected flux, so the effect of a fixed ε=10^-6 changes with scaling. Nondimensionalize states/fluxes or choose a scale-consistent ε. Use compatible units for Δt, Δx and wave speed.
methods.boundary_conditions: reconstruction._pad uses periodic ghosts, fixed initial endpoint states or edge extrapolation. Uniform high-order boundary accuracy and nonreflection are not guaranteed.

limitations.ja: 5次は滑らかな領域での空間精度であり、時間は3次。不連続近傍で同じ次数は期待できず、ε・尺度・基底の影響を受ける。段階で非正値になると時間刻みを半減して再試行するが、これは正値性の定理ではない。WENO分岐はHLLCを使わず、有限体積PPM/MUSCL用の正値再構成スケーリングも使わない。
limitations.en: Fifth order refers to smooth-region spatial accuracy; time accuracy is third order. The same order is not expected near discontinuities, and ε, scaling and basis matter. Invalid stages trigger step halving and retries, which do not constitute a positivity theorem. The WENO branch uses neither HLLC nor the positive-reconstruction scaling used by the finite-volume PPM/MUSCL branch.

assumptions_ja: 対象は1次元・一様Cartesian格子の理想気体Eulerで、各段階に有限かつ正の密度・圧力を要する。

既定は界面で固定したRoe特性基底で両流束を投影し、成分別も選べる。時間積分はSSPRK(3,3)、入力CFLは0<CFL≤0.5。

assumptions: One electron in the Coulomb potential -Z/r of an isolated, infinite-mass point nucleus; nonrelativistic and field-free.
Separate angular momentum l and solve for the reduced radial orbital u(r), normalized by integral |u|^2 dr=1.
Released inputs use Z=1,2 and (n,l)=(1,0),(2,0),(2,1),(3,2); these cases do not cover arbitrary many-electron states.
A uniform interior radial grid and a real symmetric tridiagonal second-order kinetic operator are used.
methods.units: Atomic units (hbar=m_e=e=4 pi epsilon_0=1): r in bohr, energies/effective potentials in hartree, and normalized reduced orbitals u in bohr^(-1/2).
methods.boundary_conditions: u(0)=u(r_max)=0. Released hydrogenic refinement inputs use r_max=60 bohr; a separate Z=1 1s study uses r_max=4,8,16,32 bohr. Origin and infinity are approximated by regularity and finite-box Dirichlet conditions.

limitations.ja: 一般の多電子Schrödinger方程式の直接解法、時間発展、分子、周期系、相対論・核運動・スピン軌道相互作用は未実装。小さい離散固有値残差だけでは格子・領域誤差は除けず、有限差分の固有値は連続問題の変分上界とは限らない。
limitations.en: Not a general many-electron, time-dependent, molecular, periodic or relativistic solver; nuclear motion and spin–orbit effects are absent. Small discrete eigenpair residuals do not remove grid/domain error, and finite-difference eigenvalues are not guaranteed variational upper bounds to continuum energies.

assumptions: Atomic branch: Nonrelativistic isolated He with Z=2, an infinite-mass point nucleus and two opposite-spin electrons occupying the same spherical 1s spatial orbital.
Atomic branch: Normalize integral |u|^2 dr=1 and define p=2|u|^2=4 pi r^2 n, so integral p dr=2.
Atomic branch: For this occupied orbital only, the Fock equation reduces to the effective field -2/r+v_H/2 and E_x=-E_H/2; no general nonlocal Fock operator is implemented.
Atomic branch: Single-determinant exchange is included; electron correlation is omitted.
Separate molecular branch: H2 RHF in finite s-Gaussian spaces, analytic one-/two-electron integrals and matrix SCF; see the H2 input and measured checks for its own tolerances.
methods.units: Atomic units (hbar=m_e=e=4 pi epsilon_0=1): r in bohr, energies/effective potentials in hartree, and normalized reduced orbitals u in bohr^(-1/2). Positive electron-number density n(r) is in bohr^(-3); radial number density p(r)=4 pi r^2 n(r) is in bohr^(-1), with integral p dr=N. p is not signed charge density. Molecular branch: normalized 3D AO functions in bohr^(-3/2); overlap, AO density matrix and electron count dimensionless; transformed Fock commutator in hartree. Molecular tolerances are stated separately.
methods.boundary_conditions: Helium reduced orbital: u(0)=u(r_max)=0, baseline r_max=16 bohr with a separate 4/8/12/16-bohr domain study. The Hartree field is finite at the origin and joins N/r outside the density; it is not fixed to zero at r_max. Separate H2 branch: isolated molecule, analytic whole-space Gaussian integrals; no finite radial box.

limitations.en: The local exchange reduction cannot be transferred unchanged to multi-orbital, open-shell, molecular or periodic systems. The atomic edition does not implement UHF/ROHF, molecular integrals or orbital-stability analysis. Saved PySCF RHF references are independent finite-Gaussian-basis calculations, not exact correlated helium energies. Separate grid, domain and SCF convergence from physical model error. H₂ uses a separate molecular-integral implementation. Molecular DFT, general multicenter molecules, open shells and orbital-stability analysis remain unimplemented.

assumptions: Atomic/molecular examples: Ground-state nonrelativistic isolated He with Z=2 and one doubly occupied spherical 1s Kohn–Sham orbital.
Atomic/molecular examples: p=2|u|^2=4 pi r^2 n and integral p dr=2, with n the total positive electron-number density of both spins.
Atomic/molecular examples: The adopted approximation is E_x[n]=-(3/4)(3/pi)^(1/3) integral n^(4/3) d^3r, v_x=-(3n/pi)^(1/3), and E_c=v_c=0.
Atomic/molecular examples: The effective field is -2/r+v_H+v_x; second-order radial differences and simple density mixing solve this restricted model.

Periodic KS-DFT for one fixed simple-cubic He cell. An educational PySCF workflow separately checks Gamma/k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF tolerances against independent DFTK plane waves with identical GTH parameters and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation. Does not validate equilibrium helium solids, general materials or metals.
methods.units: Atomic/molecular examples: Atomic units (hbar=m_e=e=4 pi epsilon_0=1): r in bohr, energies/effective potentials in hartree, and normalized reduced orbitals u in bohr^(-1/2). Positive electron-number density n(r) is in bohr^(-3); radial number density p(r)=4 pi r^2 n(r) is in bohr^(-1), with integral p dr=N. p is not signed charge density. Periodic He: bohr, inverse bohr and hartree per neutral primitive cell; reciprocal-lattice fractional k coordinates.
methods.boundary_conditions: Atomic/molecular examples: Helium reduced orbital: u(0)=u(r_max)=0, baseline r_max=16 bohr with a separate 4/8/12/16-bohr domain study. The Hartree field is finite at the origin and joins N/r outside the density; it is not fixed to zero at r_max. Periodic He: three-dimensional Bloch boundaries in the fixed one-atom simple-cubic cell.

next_deliverable.en: A small reproducible case with a specified exchange-correlation model.

limitations.ja: 原子・分子の実行例の範囲：厳密汎関数の理論とDirac交換のみという近似を区別する。LDA相関、GGA、meta-GGA、hybrid、スピン分極、分子、周期バンド計算、励起は未実装。格子収束や独立な同一モデルとの一致は汎関数の物理精度を保証しない。KS固有値を一般の励起エネルギーと同一視しない。 周期He側では別のPySCFドライバーがVWN5相関と周期k点積分を扱う。
limitations.en: Atomic/molecular example scope: Separate exact-functional theory from the adopted Dirac exchange-only approximation. LDA correlation, GGA, meta-GGA, hybrids, spin polarization, molecules, periodic bands and excitations are not implemented. Grid convergence or agreement with an independent implementation of the same model does not establish functional accuracy. KS eigenvalues are not generally excitation energies. A separate PySCF periodic-He driver additionally uses VWN5 correlation and periodic k-point quadrature.

assumptions: Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: The fixed-point map is the released spherical He 1s² HF or exchange-only LDA radial model, not a general molecular or periodic SCF implementation.

Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: Mix input and output radial number densities: p_next=(1-alpha)p_in+alpha p_out, 0<alpha<=1; released baseline alpha=0.35 and an alternative start uses 0.7.
Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: Each eigenproblem normalizes u and sets p_out=2|u|^2, so the electron-number normalization is imposed within the iteration.

Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: Convergence requires input/output density L1<1e-9 electrons, |energy change|<1e-10 hartree, and the output-density-rebuilt orbital residual<1e-7 hartree; maximum 300 iterations.
Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: The atlas iteration implements no DIIS, Anderson or Newton acceleration. An independent PySCF reference may use its own solver algorithms.

Atomic/molecular examples: Separate molecular branch: H2 RHF in finite s-Gaussian spaces, analytic one-/two-electron integrals and matrix SCF; see the H2 input and measured checks for its own tolerances.

Periodic KS-DFT for one fixed simple-cubic He cell. An educational PySCF workflow separately checks Gamma/k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF tolerances against independent DFTK plane waves with identical GTH parameters and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation. Does not validate equilibrium helium solids, general materials or metals.
methods.units: Atomic/molecular examples: Mixing alpha and iteration number are dimensionless. Radial p is in bohr^(-1), integral |p_out-p_in| dr is electron number, and energy changes/normalized orbital residuals are in hartree. Published tolerances belong to this normalization and model. Molecular branch: normalized 3D AO functions in bohr^(-3/2); overlap, AO density matrix and electron count dimensionless; transformed Fock commutator in hartree. Molecular tolerances are stated separately. Periodic He: bohr, inverse bohr and hartree per neutral primitive cell; reciprocal-lattice fractional k coordinates.
methods.boundary_conditions: Atomic/molecular examples: SCF mixing itself imposes no spatial boundary condition. The supplied helium fixed-point map uses reduced-orbital u(0)=u(r_max)=0 and an isolated finite-origin, N/r Hartree field; see the HF/KS/Hartree records. Separate H2 branch: isolated molecule, analytic whole-space Gaussian integrals; no finite radial box. Periodic He: three-dimensional Bloch boundaries in the fixed one-atom simple-cubic cell.

limitations.ja: 原子・分子の実行例の範囲：エネルギー変化だけで収束を宣言しない。電子数が2に保たれることは実装の整合性検査であり、独立な物理検証ではない。異なる初期値での一致も解の一意性・軌道安定性・大域的最低エネルギーを証明しない。Pulay文献は未採用の加速法の文脈用で、単純密度混合の実装出典ではない。 H₂では別の分子積分実装を用いる。分子DFT・一般多中心分子・開殻・軌道安定性解析は未実装。 周期He側では別のPySCFドライバーがVWN5相関と周期k点積分を扱う。
limitations.en: Atomic/molecular example scope: Energy change alone is insufficient. Electron number staying at two is an imposed consistency check, not independent physical validation. Agreement from alternative starts does not prove uniqueness, orbital stability or a global energy minimum. The Pulay reference is context for an unimplemented acceleration method, not the source of the simple density-mixing implementation. H₂ uses a separate molecular-integral implementation. Molecular DFT, general multicenter molecules, open shells and orbital-stability analysis remain unimplemented. A separate PySCF periodic-He driver additionally uses VWN5 correlation and periodic k-point quadrature.

assumptions: A nonnegative spherically symmetric electron-number density n(r), with p(r)=4 pi r^2 n(r) and integral p dr=N; released helium uses N=2.
For an isolated system, v_H(r)=integral_0^R p(s)/max(r,s) ds and E_H=(1/2) integral p(r)v_H(r) dr.
The code uses uniform-grid cumulative quadrature with p=0 at the two endpoints and zero density outside the finite box; the same-radius quadrature sample is counted once.

v_H is positive electron repulsion and satisfies Laplacian(v_H)=-4 pi n in atomic units. Signed electronic charge density is -n; v_H is electron potential energy, not the electrostatic potential generated by that negative charge.
methods.units: Atomic units: r in bohr, n in bohr^(-3), p in bohr^(-1), N an electron number, v_H and E_H in hartree. The positive-number-density convention fixes the Poisson sign.
methods.boundary_conditions: Isolated spherical Coulomb boundary: v_H is finite at the origin and equals N/r outside the truncated density support. It is not a zero-Dirichlet condition at r_max. Endpoint p=0 is inherited from the reduced orbital; no periodic neutrality/background convention is implemented.

limitations.ja: 球対称・孤立・有限箱で切断した密度用の積分評価。非球対称、一般の境界形状、周期系、Ewaldや背景電荷、点電荷の特異自己エネルギーは扱わない。同半径標本の重複回避は求積の会計であり、DFTの物理的自己相互作用を除去する操作ではない。He HFでの自己相互作用相殺は別の交換簡約に由来する。
limitations.en: An integral evaluator for spherical isolated densities truncated in a finite box. It does not treat nonspherical/general boundaries, periodicity, Ewald/background charges or singular point-charge self-energies. Avoiding a double-counted same-radius sample is quadrature bookkeeping, not removal of DFT self-interaction; the helium-HF cancellation comes from the separate exchange reduction.

assumptions_ja: 非負・球対称の電子数密度n(r)を仮定。p(r)=4πr²n(r)、∫p dr=Nと定義し、公開He例はN=2。
孤立系のv_H(r)=∫₀ᴿp(s)/max(r,s)dsとE_H=(1/2)∫p(r)v_H(r)drを評価する。
一様格子の累積求積を用い、両端p=0、有限箱外の密度は0とする。同じ半径の求積標本を1回だけ数える。
v_Hは正の電子間反発で、原子単位系で∇²v_H=−4πn。符号付き電子電荷密度は−nであり、v_Hは負電荷が作る静電ポテンシャルそのものではなく電子のポテンシャルエネルギー。
methods.units_ja: 原子単位系。rはbohr、nはbohr⁻³、pはbohr⁻¹、Nは電子数、v_HとE_Hはhartree。正の電子数密度という規約とPoisson式の符号を組にする。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: 孤立・球対称Coulomb境界。v_Hは原点で有限、切断した密度の外側ではN/r。r_maxで0とするDirichlet条件ではない。端点p=0は縮約軌道から与え、周期系の中性化・背景電荷の規約は実装していない。

caution.ja: Poisson解の残差、積分した電子数、遠方の挙動、二重計数の1/2を別々に確かめます。周期セルの帯電系を孤立系のエネルギーとして解釈しません。
caution.en: Check the Poisson residual, integrated electron number, far-field behavior and the one-half double-counting factor separately. A charged periodic cell does not directly give an isolated-system energy.

example_scope.ja: 球対称孤立密度のCoulomb積分を累積和で評価。解析的な指数密度で符号・係数・自己項の数え方を検証。一般の3Dや周期のPoisson実装ではありません。

Check sign, boundaries and accounting against analytic exponential density and the N/r far field.

同じ求積の標本を1回にする処理を、点電荷自己エネルギー除去や交換と混同する。
en: Applying this one-dimensional Coulomb integral directly to nonspherical or periodic systems.
Confusing quadrature sample counting with point-charge self-energy removal or exchange.

reason.ja: 球対称求積、求積の対角標本、物理的自己相互作用を区別。

summary.en: Distinguish functional ingredients and model error. Isolated He uses Dirac exchange only; the fixed periodic-He example uses LDA_X plus VWN5 correlation. GGA, meta-GGA and hybrids remain reading only.

assumptions: Atomic/molecular examples: Use the total spin-unpolarized positive number density n=n_up+n_down, with n_up=n_down=n/2; in the radial example n=p/(4 pi r^2).
Atomic/molecular examples: The implemented exchange is E_x=-(3/4)(3/pi)^(1/3) integral n^(4/3) d^3r and v_x=delta E_x/delta n=-(3n/pi)^(1/3), hence E_x=(3/4) integral p v_x dr.
Atomic/molecular examples: Set E_c=v_c=0 explicitly. This is not LDA plus a correlation parameterization and not Slater X-alpha with an unspecified coefficient.
Atomic/molecular examples: The public execution uses spherical closed-shell He 1s² and independently compares the same exchange-only choice against PySCF with xc='LDA_X,'.

Periodic KS-DFT for one fixed simple-cubic He cell. An educational PySCF workflow separately checks Gamma/k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF tolerances against independent DFTK plane waves with identical GTH parameters and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation. Does not validate equilibrium helium solids, general materials or metals.
methods.units: Atomic/molecular examples: Atomic units: total number density n in bohr^(-3), radial p in bohr^(-1), local v_x in hartree, and integrated E_x in hartree. The energy functional and its derivative use the same density and spin convention. Periodic He: bohr, inverse bohr and hartree per neutral primitive cell; reciprocal-lattice fractional k coordinates.
methods.boundary_conditions: Atomic/molecular examples: The local exchange functional itself has no spatial boundary condition. The density/orbital problem supplies the isolated helium box and normalization. Gradient, nonlocal-exchange or periodic-functional boundaries are outside this implementation. Periodic He: three-dimensional Bloch boundaries in the fixed one-atom simple-cubic cell.

next_deliverable.ja: 使用する汎関数・グリッド・基底の明示と出典整理。
next_deliverable.en: Document functional, grid, basis and primary references.

limitations.ja: 原子・分子の実行例の範囲：相関、スピン分極、密度勾配、運動エネルギー密度、非局所交換を含まない。PBE・SCAN・hybridを実装・検証したという意味ではない。同一汎関数の独立実装との一致や格子収束は、交換相関モデルの精度・自己相互作用誤差・実験への一致を保証しない。Dirac原論文のThomas原子近似と本例のKS軌道解法を区別する。 周期He側では別のPySCFドライバーがVWN5相関と周期k点積分を扱う。
limitations.en: Atomic/molecular example scope: No correlation, spin polarization, density gradients, kinetic-energy-density ingredients or nonlocal exchange. PBE, SCAN and hybrid methods are not implemented or validated here. Agreement with an independent implementation of the same functional or grid convergence does not establish model accuracy, eliminate self-interaction error or guarantee experimental agreement. Distinguish Dirac's historical Thomas-atom approximation from this KS orbital solver. A separate PySCF periodic-He driver additionally uses VWN5 correlation and periodic k-point quadrature.

assumptions_ja: 原子・分子の実行例：両スピンを合計した正の電子数密度n=n_up+n_downを用い、n_up=n_down=n/2のスピン非偏極を仮定。動径例ではn=p/(4πr²)。
原子・分子の実行例：実装はE_x=−(3/4)(3/π)¹ᐟ³∫n⁴ᐟ³d³r、v_x=δE_x/δn=−(3n/π)¹ᐟ³で、E_x=(3/4)∫p v_x dr。
原子・分子の実行例：E_c=v_c=0を明示する。相関のパラメータ化を追加したLDAでも、係数不明のSlater Xαでもない。
原子・分子の実行例：公開実行は球対称・閉殻He 1s²。独立参照もxc='LDA_X,'と指定し、同じ交換のみ近似を比較する。
固定した1原子単純立方Heセルの周期KS-DFT。PySCFを使う教育用ワークフローで、Γ点／k点、Gaussian軌道基底、FFT補助格子、SCF公差を別々に検査し、同じGTHパラメータ・LDA交換＋VWN5相関のDFTK平面波計算と比較。平衡He結晶や一般物質・金属の検証ではありません。
methods.units_ja: 原子・分子の実行例：原子単位系。全電子数密度nはbohr⁻³、動径密度pはbohr⁻¹、局所v_xと積分したE_xはhartree。エネルギー汎関数とその微分で密度・スピンの規約をそろえる。 周期He：bohr・逆bohr・中性基本セル当たりhartree、逆格子での分率k座標。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: 原子・分子の実行例：局所交換汎関数自体には空間境界条件はない。密度・軌道の問題が孤立Heの箱と規格化を与える。勾配項・非局所交換・周期系の境界処理は実装対象外。 周期He：固定1原子単純立方セルの3次元Bloch境界。

caution.ja: 基底・格子・SCFが収束しても汎関数の近似誤差は消えません。自己相互作用、電荷移動、強相関、分散の扱いは対象と近似に応じて評価します。
caution.en: Basis, grid and SCF convergence do not remove functional error. Assess self-interaction, charge transfer, strong correlation and dispersion for the chosen system and approximation.

limitations.ja: 小規模な滑らかなBratu下側分枝と固定合成観測による教育用検証。2パラメータ空間係数の推定、Tikhonov正則化、局所的なデータ感度のSVD、中央観測の階数不足と反射対称性による曖昧さを扱う。正則化による事前値の選択を観測情報の増加と解釈しない。実測データ、多数係数の関数推定、大域的一意性、統計的信頼区間、準Newton法全般は検証しない。
limitations.en: Educational tests use small smooth lower-branch Bratu problems and fixed synthetic observations. They cover two spatial coefficients, Tikhonov regularization, local data-sensitivity SVD, rank loss with central observations and reflection ambiguity. Prior selection through regularization does not add observational information. Real data, high-dimensional function estimation, global uniqueness, statistical confidence intervals and quasi-Newton methods generally are outside scope.
